s: If working on a new Mac with the M1/2/etc. chip, I currently think (original date of this suggestion is Jun-2022; still holds Nov-2023) it’s best to install the regular Intel version, rather than the available Apple M1 version on the download page. This is because not a lot of packages in conda have M1 versions built yet, and the M1 computers come with software (called rosetta) that will ask to be installed the first time it’s needed, but then tries to make it so intel-based things work on the M1.
